$comment: Inherited kaneo routes that do not yet declare a route policy.
This is NOT an allowlist and it is NOT permanent. It is the retrofit backlog for issue #8,
and it only ever shrinks: route-coverage.test.ts fails if an entry here has since been
given a policy, and fails if an entry names a route the router no longer has. Adding a
line is therefore a visible, reviewable act, and a new route that nobody declared a policy
for fails the build rather than landing here quietly.
Most of these disappear rather than get classified: #6 deletes the six integration routers,
billing, the MCP HTTP surface, the OAuth router and the public-project route. Delete the
line in the same change that deletes or classifies the route.
Generated against the inherited surface on 2026-09-06 (issue #7); shrunk from 128 to 80
entries on 2026-09-07 when #16 deleted 48 of these routes (issue #6). Shrunk from 80 to
1 on 2026-09-22 when the five #8 classification lanes (task, board-structure,
comms-discovery, identity-access, platform-inline) plus the GET /api/asset/{id}
registration-order fix landed together, classifying every remaining route except one.
Shrunk from 1 to 0 on 2026-09-27 (PR #440's Opus delta pass F4): the sole survivor,
deprecated and its own handler permanently disabled, rather than deleted outright, per
